observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 260 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -28
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page(viewport={"width":1366,"height":900})
    pg.goto("https://www.kaggle.com/account/login",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=90000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    try:
        pg.click("text=Create one",timeout=10000)
    except Exception as e: print("klik gagal:",type(e).__name__)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(6000)
    print("URL:",pg.url)
    print("BODY:",pg.inner_text("body")[:700].replace("\n"," | "))
    for inp in pg.locator("input").all():
        n=inp.get_attribute("name"); t=inp.get_attribute("type")
        if t!="hidden": print("input:",n,"|",t)
    print("tombol:",[bt.inner_text()[:25] for bt in pg.locator("button").all() if bt.inner_text().strip()][:8])
    b.close()
PY
